text:
Every (episode, follower) pair is covered with 6 paid periods, costing $95.89 in total. No `maxConcurrent` limit is set, so overlapping services are allowed.

**Tidewell: no periods.** It is already paid through 2026-11-18. That covers Quiet Ferry's leaving window (2026-11-01 to 2026-11-14) for Theo and Rosa. Nothing else is on Tidewell.

**Marquee: 1 period ($13.99).** Velvet Tide is available from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-27 for Theo and Priya. Any single month starting in that range covers it, so I start on 2026-11-01.

**Orbit: 2 periods ($21.98).** It is already paid through 2026-11-07, which covers The Velvet Signal episode 1 (released 11-06) for Priya.
- **Period from 2026-11-20 to 2026-12-20.** This covers episode 2, whose window is 11-13 to 11-20, so it is caught on the last day. It also covers episodes 3 to 7 (11-20, 11-27, 12-04, 12-11, 12-18).
- **Period from 2027-01-01 to 2027-02-01.** This covers episode 8 (window 12-25 to 01-01) and episode 9 (01-01). It also covers all of The Northern Tide, released 01-27, for Rosa.
- **Why one period can't do it:** the episode windows run from 11-13 to 01-08, which is more than one month.

**Pebble Kids: 3 periods ($23.97).** Theo has the tightest windows on The Crooked Meridian: each episode's release date plus 3 days. The first window ends 12-07 and the last starts 02-19.
- **Why two periods aren't enough:** two consecutive months starting no later than 12-07 end before 02-08. That cannot reach 02-19.
- **Period from 2026-12-07 to 2027-01-07.** Covers episodes released 12-04, 12-11, 12-18, 12-25 and 01-01.
- **Period from 2027-01-11 to 2027-02-11.** Covers episodes released 01-08, 01-15, 01-22, 01-29 and 02-05.
- **Period from 2027-02-12 to 2027-03-12.** Covers episodes released 02-12 and 02-19.
- Priya and Rosa have longer windows, so they are covered by the same periods.

No periods of the same service overlap each other or the already-paid access.

